page.overview:
Who is Auroraceratops?

is an extinct genus of bipedal basal neoceratopsian dinosaur from the Aptian stage of the Early Cretaceous period in the north central part of China. Its name means "dawn horned face" and refers to its status as an early ceratopsian and also to Dawn Dodson, the wife of Peter Dodson, one of the paleontologists who described the animal.

While it does not appear in the film itself, a silhouette of Auroraceratops is shown in the CIA Black Market tracker list during the events of Jurassic World: Dominion. This could imply that Auroraceratops was created at some point in 2022.
